what_changed: CFPB proposes amending Regulation B provisions on disparate impact, discouragement of applicants and prospective applicants, and special purpose credit programs.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change until final; if adopted as proposed, the CFPB's reading of ECOA would change on disparate impact, which can reach collection and servicing treatment of borrowers (Regulation B covers collection procedures).
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Does the deployment test collection and settlement treatment for disparate impact across borrower groups, and would that testing change if the proposal is adopted?
rationale: Reg B proposal centered on applications and discouragement; the disparate impact part may reach servicing and collection treatment under REGB-001, which the abstract does not settle. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
